ad_info.structure_source: library format F57 (Flat illustration body before/after with product on pedestal and lists below) — structure vg-08
ad_info.reference_style: Flat vector illustration before/after ad with the real product on a pedestal, a circular offer seal and two check lists
ad_info.angle_used: Testimonial: naturally slim young women (18 to 25) whose jeans finally fit

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (circular seal ring, check marks), deep magenta #B0105E (script line), dark plum #2B1226 (headline, list text, center label), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE (background), white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: soft fuchsia center stripe #F7B6D2, denim blues #5B7FA6 (light wash) and #2E3F66 (dark wash), warm tan skin #D9A07A.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean flat vector illustration with soft gradients and gentle shading for the bodies; the real bottle photographic, sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Celebratory and young, a happy 'it's official' moment.
global_identity.graphic_language: Vertical soft stripe behind the center, two rounded flat pedestals, one circular stamp seal, simple ✗ and ✓ list markers, small sparkles near the 'after' figure.
global_identity.text_typography: 'ES OFICIAL:' in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look); the second line in a flowing bold script/italic (Pacifico / brush script look); lists and center label in Poppins SemiBold / Bold.

creative_objective: Speak in the voice of a slim young woman who finally sees her jeans fit: same body in profile before and after, the bottle as the hero between them, the 3-month plan stamped on a seal, and two lists that read like her own words.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) 'ES OFICIAL:' headline and script line. 2) The two profile bodies and the bottle on its pedestal. 3) The circular plan seal. 4) The ✗/✓ lists and center label. 5) The seal line.
art_direction.composition_style: Symmetric three-column layout: before body left, bottle center, after body right; headline across the top; lists in two columns below with the label in the center column.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 0-22%; bodies and bottle 22-74%; lists 75-95%; seal line 96-99%. The center stripe runs top to bottom behind the bottle and the center label.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration with soft vertical gradients; the bottle with a soft studio highlight and a small contact shadow on the pedestal.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top: two-line headline, a heavy 'Es oficial:' and a script line with the promise. Middle: the same illustrated body in profile, before on the left and after on the right, from waist to legs, each on a rounded pedestal; product on a taller pedestal in the center; a circular seal overlapping the lower right of the product. Bottom: ✗ list on the left, ✓ list on the right, bold label in the center column. Vertical lighter stripe behind the center.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: 'ES OFICIAL:' + script 'mi jean por fin me horma'
Slim young woman in profile, waist to knees, loose light-wash jeans flat at the back
Same woman, another day, fitted dark-wash jeans, rounder hip and glute, believable
Real closed bottle on a round flat pedestal
Only 'PLAN DE 3 MESES · 3 FRASCOS', no price, stars or customer counts

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Before vs after in her words

forbidden_additions: Customer counts, reviews, star ratings or numbers in the circular seal
Faces or upper bodies in underwear: the bodies are from the waist to the knees, wearing jeans and a top
Loose capsules or an open bottle

visual_prompt:
Square 1:1 flat vector illustration ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; ignore any hand or surface in that photo. If a layout reference image is attached, use it ONLY for the position of the blocks; never copy its text, brand, product, bodies or colors.

BACKGROUND: pale blush pink #FBE3EE with a soft vertical center stripe in light fuchsia #F7B6D2 (about 30% of the width) running from top to bottom, subtle soft gradients, a few faint illustrated leaf silhouettes in the lower corners and small white sparkles near the right figure.

TOP (0-22% of height): centered headline in two lines. Line 1: 'ES OFICIAL:' in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, dark plum #2B1226, large. Line 2: 'mi jean por fin me horma' in a flowing bold script/italic (brush script look), deep magenta #B0105E, slightly larger than line 1, with a thin white outline for contrast.

CENTER (22-74%): three columns. LEFT column: a flat illustrated side profile of a slim young Colombian woman of about 22 (adult proportions), facing right, shown only from the waist to just below the knees, standing on a low rounded pedestal in soft magenta. BEFORE (a different day): a loose grey crop tee hem visible at the waist, light-wash denim jeans #5B7FA6 that hang loose and baggy at the back, the fabric making empty vertical folds below the glute, flat hip line, slightly slouched posture. RIGHT column: the SAME woman, same height and scale, facing left, on an identical pedestal. AFTER (another day): a fitted hot fuchsia top hem, dark-wash jeans #2E3F66 that fit snugly at the back with a visibly rounder, fuller hip and glute curve and smooth fabric without empty folds, upright confident posture, small sparkles beside her. The difference is clear but believable, never exaggerated, never sexual. Flat skin #D9A07A with soft shading. CENTER column: ONE closed real bottle standing upright on a taller round pedestal in pale pink with a darker fuchsia rim, the bottle about 34% of the canvas height, label facing the camera, straight on, fully legible and never mirrored, photographic and sharp: matte black cylinder about 1.6 times taller than wide, straight sides, no neck, wide glossy hot-pink #E6177F cap almost as wide as the body with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with the huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1', the pink banner, italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and the three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE + 400mg FENOGRECO + 200mg MACA NEGRA'; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Overlapping the lower right corner of the bottle's pedestal, a circular stamp seal about 20% of the width: white disc with a thick hot fuchsia #E6177F ring; inside, in dark plum Poppins ExtraBold, 'PLAN DE 3 MESES' on top and '3 FRASCOS' below, separated by a small dot; no other text, no stars.

BOTTOM (75-95%): LEFT column list, Poppins SemiBold, dark plum #2B1226, each item with a thin dark plum ✗ marker: 'El jean me quedaba suelto atrás', 'Hacía sentadillas sin ver cambios', 'Evitaba las fotos de cuerpo entero'. CENTER column, on the stripe: 'Mi plan natural' in Poppins ExtraBold, dark plum, two lines centered. RIGHT column list, Poppins SemiBold, dark plum, each item with a hot fuchsia ✓ marker: 'El jean me horma', 'Le cumplo a mi rutina', 'Me tomo fotos con ganas'.

VERY BOTTOM (96-99%): one small centered line in Poppins SemiBold, dark plum #2B1226: 'AGREGAR LOGO Y SELLO DE REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.

mandatory_visual_elements: The same slim woman illustrated in profile from the waist to the knees, before (left, loose light jeans) and after (right, fitted dark jeans)
The real closed bottle on a center pedestal, label legible
Circular stamp seal with fuchsia ring
Two lists with ✗ and ✓ markers and the center label
Soft fuchsia vertical center stripe on a blush background
final_generation_exclusions: No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle.
No stars, ratings, customer counts or prices in the seal or anywhere.
No underwear, no bare midriff close-ups, nothing sexualized.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. First-person, unnamed voice; no figures, no guaranteed result, the change is tied to routine and plan.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
